typography.instructions: Use 'Outfit' for all headings to give a modern, geometric, and authoritative telecom feel. Do not use Inter or Roboto for headings. Use 'Manrope' for body text to ensure extreme legibility on forms and dashboards. Apply 'tracking-tight' to headings H1-H3.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces. SFR branding is known for its iconic square logo. Therefore, use sharp edges (rounded-none) for cards, buttons, and inputs to create a 'Swiss High-Contrast' and structured, premium aesthetic. Avoid soft, heavily rounded corners.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid glassmorphism for this financial/telecom context. Use solid backgrounds for clarity and trust, especially on the payment form and login page.

layouts.login_page: Split-screen layout (lg:grid-cols-2). The left side should feature a brand-relevant lifestyle image with a subtle dark or red overlay. The right side is a clean, centered, high-contrast white form for login/reset password. Always include clear error states and 'Forgot Password / Username' links.
layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). A side navigation or a prominent top navigation bar (solid white with a bottom border). Content area uses a bento-style grid for 'Unpaid Invoices'. Generous padding (p-6 to p-8) inside cards.
layouts.payment_flow: Centered, narrow column layout (max-w-2xl) for the Credit Card form to maintain focus. Stepper or progress indicator at the top. The form must feel highly secure (use lock icons, clear field separations).
layouts.header: Solid white background (bg-white) with a subtle bottom border. Do not use transparent headers.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none), bold text, primary color (#E2001A) for primary actions. Must have a distinct hover state (e.g., darker red) and focus ring.
components.inputs: Sharp edges, 1px solid border. High contrast text. Use Shadcn UI forms. Must include validation states (red borders for errors) and error text directly below the input.
components.tables: Clean, flat tables for invoice lists. Minimalist borders. Highlight unpaid invoices with an accent or badge.
components.loaders: For the payment processing screen, use a prominent, trustworthy loading animation (e.g., a spinning circle in primary red, accompanied by text 'Traitement de votre paiement sécurisé...').
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow by default, slight lift on hover for interactive cards.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all clickable elements. Focus rings for accessibility.
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform), avoid 'transition-all'.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in for page loads, especially transitioning from the payment form to the loader, and loader to the success receipt.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. The red primary color must only be used on white backgrounds or as a background with white text.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-invalid for form errors, aria-live for the payment processing status.
accessibility.test_ids: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='cc-number-input').

images.instructions: Use on the left side of the split-screen login page, preferably with a dark or slight red tint overlay.

images.description: Person holding a credit card typing on a laptop
images.instructions: Can be used as a subtle banner on the dashboard or as an illustrative element near the payment section if needed.

specific_flows.auth_flow: Login -> Error messages if invalid -> Links to 'Mot de passe oublié' & 'Identifiant oublié' -> Reset forms -> Dashboard
specific_flows.payment_flow: Dashboard -> Factures impayées -> Sélection facture -> Formulaire CB (Luhn validation, Date, CVV, Nom) -> Traitement (Loader screen) -> Success (Reçu avec montant, ref, IBAN masqué, bouton PDF) OR Error (Message clair + Retry). Once paid, return to invoice list shows 'Payée' status.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'lucide-react' for icons (e.g., Lock, CreditCard, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle).
Implement the payment processing as a distinct screen (or full-overlay modal) with a loader, simulating a 2-3 second delay before showing the success/error screen.
The PDF receipt button should be prominent and styled as a secondary action on the success screen.
Apply 'data-testid' to ALL form inputs, buttons, and error messages.
Do NOT center align the entire App container.
Use standard Shadcn components but strip the default rounded corners by adding 'rounded-none' or configuring the theme to 0 radius.
For the SFR brand feel, keep it strictly professional, high-contrast, and red/white dominated.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep surfaces flat for this specific brand.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Missing image categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
